notes: Older Resolve: captions no longer land at the end of the video; they go on a new subtitle track at their own time.
Earlier subtitle tracks are turned off so only the new captions show. Undo turns them back on.
Captions open sooner after Workspace > Scripts > Srutilekha: the tray helper notices the click within 0.1 s.
On Resolve 21.2 new captions are moved onto their own new subtitle track, at the right time.
